memes.speaker: senior.expert@sdworx.example
memes.statement: Onboarding checklist for a new freelancer: check the company number in the KBO/BCE public search; collect proof of affiliation with a social insurance fund; for foreign freelancers, get the Limosa L1 receipt and the A1 certificate; sign a contract without fixed working hours.

quotes.speaker: senior.expert@sdworx.example
quotes.text:
Proposal for the onboarding checklist for every new freelancer:
1. check the company number in the KBO/BCE public search
2. collect proof of affiliation with a social insurance fund
3. for foreign freelancers: Limosa L1 receipt and A1 certificate
4. signed contract without fixed working hours

quote.text: Approved — this is our checklist from now on.
